name: Weaviate
shortInfo: Weaviate is an open-source vector database with search, filtering, and cloud scalability.
brief: Weaviate Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to Weaviate Vector Database in an automated manner.
about: Weaviate is an AI-native vector database that makes it easy for developers of all levels to build AI applications
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/weaviate/syncs/export.html)

This sync can be used to load data from a user specified data warehouse to the Weaviate platform.
